 Context. The sonnet requires situating within two sets of circumstances. The first relates
to its Harvard Nbk 1 title and concerns the position of Benevento, a small Ecclesiastical
State thirty miles or so northeast of Naples, in the summer of 1820 relative to the con-
stitutional government in Naples. The second pertains to its Box 2 title and refers to the
crisis in the Italian peninsula as a whole in February 1821.
